```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(here)
# Load libraries
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, out.width="100%", out.height="100%")

# Source scripts for initializing monolix and functions to run the analysis
source(here("scripts", "initialize_monolix.R"))
source(here("scripts", "functions.R"))

data <- read_delim(here("data", "derived", "STUDY2_DATA.txt"), delim = "\t")

theme_set(theme_minimal())
```

## Analysis without any fixed parameters

```{r}
## Results before fixing parameters ####
study <- "study2"
project_name <- "IGS_no_cov.mlxtran"
out_folder <- here("results_eclipse", study)

# Load Project and Results
loadProject(here(out_folder, project_name))
load(here(out_folder, str_remove(project_name, "\\.mlxtran$"), "IGS.RData"))

# Top 95% of cumulative probability
runs_95 <- calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% filter(cumprob <= 0.95) %>% pull(run)
length(runs_95)

distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc) %>%
  ggplot(aes("BICc", bicc, color = run %in% runs_95)) + geom_beeswarm()

calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>%
  ggplot(aes(bicc, cumprob, color = run %in% runs_95)) + geom_point()

plot_bicc_v_estimate(tabestimates, color = runs_95)

tabestimates_95 <- tabestimates %>% filter(run %in% runs_95)
estimate_boxplots(tabestimates_95)
compare_estimates(tabestimates_95)

# Best 10 runs
runs_10 <- tabestimates %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% arrange(bicc) %>% slice(1:10) %>% pull(run)
length(runs_10)

distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc) %>%
  ggplot(aes("BICc", bicc, color = run %in% runs_10)) + geom_beeswarm()

calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>%
  ggplot(aes(bicc, cumprob, color = run %in% runs_10)) + geom_point()

plot_bicc_v_estimate(tabestimates, color = runs_10)

tabestimates_10 <- tabestimates %>% filter(run %in% runs_10)
estimate_boxplots(tabestimates_10)
compare_estimates(tabestimates_10)

# Individual parameter distributions for best 10 runs
indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>%
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), EBE, color = bicc, fill = bicc)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) + geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") + scale_y_log10() +
  color_bicc() + fill_bicc()

indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>%
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>%
  ggplot(aes(EBE, fill = factor(run), color = factor(run))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_log10() + labs(color = "run", fill = "run")

# Plot parameter distributions for best 10 runs
df <- merge(
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("pop", parameter)) %>%
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter", "temp")) %>%
    select(parameter, run, estimate, bicc) %>% rename(mean = estimate),
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("omega", parameter)) %>%
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("temp", "parameter")) %>%
    select(parameter, run, estimate, bicc) %>% rename(sd = estimate)
)

density_data <- df %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_vals <- exp(seq((min(log(.x$mean) - 4*.x$sd)),
                      (max(log(.x$mean) + 4*.x$sd)),
                      length.out = 500))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(.x), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        x = x_vals,
        y = dnorm(log(x_vals), mean = log(.x$mean[i]), sd = .x$sd[i]),
        run = as.factor(.x$run[i])
      )
    }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

density_data %>%
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% mutate(run = factor(run))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, color = bicc, group = run)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Normal Distributions by Parameter",
       x = "Value", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() + color_bicc() +
  scale_x_log10()

# Shrinkage for each parameter
shrinkage %>%
  filter(run %in% runs_10) %>%
  left_join(distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), conditionalMode, fill = bicc)) +
  geom_col() + geom_hline(yintercept = 30, lty = "dashed") +
  fill_bicc() + facet_wrap(~parameter) +
  labs(x = "Run", y = "Shrinkage (%)")
```


## Analysis after fixing parameters 

```{r}
## Results after fixing parameters ####

study <- "study2"
project_name <- "IGS_no_cov_fixed_param.mlxtran"
out_folder <- here("results_eclipse", study)
# Load Project
loadProject(here(out_folder, project_name))
# Load results from IGS over narrow range
load(here(out_folder, str_remove(project_name, "\\.mlxtran$"), "IGS.RData"))

# top 95% of cumulative probability
runs_95 <- calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% filter(cumprob <= 0.95) %>% pull(run)
length(runs_95)

distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc) %>% 
  ggplot(aes("BICc", bicc, color = run %in% runs_95)) + 
  geom_beeswarm()

calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(bicc, cumprob, color = run %in% runs_95)) + 
  geom_point()

plot_bicc_v_estimate(tabestimates, color = runs_95)

tabestimates_95 <- tabestimates %>% filter(run %in% runs_95)

estimate_boxplots(tabestimates_95)

compare_estimates(tabestimates_95)


# best 10 runs
runs_10 <- tabestimates %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% arrange(bicc) %>% slice(1:10) %>% pull(run)
length(runs_10)

distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc) %>% 
  ggplot(aes("BICc", bicc, color = run %in% runs_10)) + 
  geom_beeswarm()

calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(bicc, cumprob, color = run %in% runs_10)) + 
  geom_point()

plot_bicc_v_estimate(tabestimates, color = runs_10)

tabestimates_10 <- tabestimates %>% filter(run %in% runs_10)

estimate_boxplots(tabestimates_10)

compare_estimates(tabestimates_10)

## Look at individual parameter distributions for the best 10 runs

indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>% 
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), EBE, color = bicc, fill = bicc)) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  color_bicc() + 
  fill_bicc()

indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(EBE, fill = factor(run), color = factor(run))) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  labs(color = "run", fill = "run") 

## Plot parameter distributions for the best 10 runs:

df <- merge(
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("pop", parameter)) %>% 
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter", "temp")) %>% 
    select(parameter, run, estimate) %>% rename(mean = estimate) %>% 
    rbind(data.frame(parameter = "lambda", mean = 50, run = runs_10),
          data.frame(parameter = "p", mean = 0.7, run = runs_10)),
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("omega", parameter)) %>% 
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("temp", "parameter")) %>% 
    select(parameter, run, estimate, bicc) %>% rename(sd = estimate)
) 

density_data <- df %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_vals <- exp(seq((min(log(.x$mean) - 4*.x$sd)),
                      (max(log(.x$mean) + 4*.x$sd)),
                      length.out = 500))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(.x), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        x = x_vals,
        y = dnorm(log(x_vals), mean = log(.x$mean[i]), sd = .x$sd[i]),
        run = as.factor(.x$run[i])
      )
    }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


# Plot with facets for each parameter
density_data %>% 
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% mutate(run = factor(run))) %>% 
  ggplot( aes(x = x, y = y, color = bicc, group = run)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Normal Distributions by Parameter",
       x = "Value",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  color_bicc() + 
  scale_x_log10()


# Shrinkage for each parameter
shrinkage %>% 
  filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), conditionalMode, fill = bicc)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, lty = "dashed") +
  fill_bicc() + 
  facet_wrap(~parameter) + 
  labs(x = "Run", y = "Shrinkage (%)") 
```

## Analysis with treatment effects

```{r}
## Results for model wtih treatment effects ###

study <- "study2"
project_name <- "IGS_am2.mlxtran"
out_folder <- here("results_eclipse", study, "IGS_model_comparison")
# Load Project
loadProject(here(out_folder, project_name))
# Load results from IGS over narrow range
load(here(out_folder, str_remove(project_name, "\\.mlxtran$"), "IGS.RData"))


# top 95% of cumulative probability
runs_95 <- calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% filter(cumprob <= 0.95) %>% pull(run)
length(runs_95)

distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc) %>% 
  ggplot(aes("BICc", bicc, color = run %in% runs_95)) + 
  geom_beeswarm()

calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(bicc, cumprob, color = run %in% runs_95)) + 
  geom_point()

plot_bicc_v_estimate(tabestimates, color = runs_95)

tabestimates_95 <- tabestimates %>% filter(run %in% runs_95)

estimate_boxplots(tabestimates_95)

compare_estimates(tabestimates_95)


# best 10 runs
runs_10 <- tabestimates %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% arrange(bicc) %>% slice(1:10) %>% pull(run)
length(runs_10)

distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc) %>% 
  ggplot(aes("BICc", bicc, color = run %in% runs_10)) + 
  geom_beeswarm()

calculate_BICw(tabestimates) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(bicc, cumprob, color = run %in% runs_10)) + 
  geom_point()

plot_bicc_v_estimate(tabestimates, color = runs_10)

tabestimates_10 <- tabestimates %>% filter(run %in% runs_10)

estimate_boxplots(tabestimates_10)

compare_estimates(tabestimates_10)

## Look at individual parameter distributions for the best 10 runs

indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>% 
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), EBE, color = bicc, fill = bicc)) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  color_bicc() + 
  fill_bicc()


indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>% 
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc)) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(data, id, tlr7, vac) %>% mutate(id = as.character(id))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), EBE, color = bicc, fill = bicc)) + 
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point() + 
  facet_grid(parameter ~ interaction(vac, tlr7), scales = "free_y") + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  color_bicc() + 
  fill_bicc()



indivParams %>% filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  pivot_longer(!c(id, run), names_to = "parameter", values_to = "EBE") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(EBE, fill = factor(run), color = factor(run))) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  labs(color = "run", fill = "run") 

## Plot parameter distributions for the best 10 runs:

df <- merge(
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("pop", parameter)) %>% 
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter", "temp")) %>% 
    select(parameter, run, estimate) %>% rename(mean = estimate) %>% 
    rbind(data.frame(parameter = "lambda", mean = 50, run = runs_10),
          data.frame(parameter = "p", mean = 0.7, run = runs_10)),
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("omega", parameter)) %>% 
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("temp", "parameter")) %>% 
    select(parameter, run, estimate, bicc) %>% rename(sd = estimate)
) 

density_data <- df %>%
  group_by(parameter) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_vals <- exp(seq((min(log(.x$mean) - 4*.x$sd)),
                      (max(log(.x$mean) + 4*.x$sd)),
                      length.out = 500))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(.x), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        x = x_vals,
        y = dnorm(log(x_vals), mean = log(.x$mean[i]), sd = .x$sd[i]),
        run = as.factor(.x$run[i])
      )
    }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


# Plot with facets for each parameter
density_data %>% 
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% mutate(run = factor(run))) %>% 
  ggplot( aes(x = x, y = y, color = bicc, group = run)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Normal Distributions by Parameter",
       x = "Value",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  color_bicc() + 
  scale_x_log10()

df <- merge(
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(parameter %in% c("ta_pop", "NPs_pop")) %>% 
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("parameter", "temp")) %>% 
    select(parameter, run, estimate) %>% rename(mean = estimate),
  tabestimates_10 %>% filter(parameter %in% c("omega_ta", "omega_NPs")) %>% 
    separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("temp", "parameter")) %>% 
    select(parameter, run, estimate, bicc) %>% rename(sd = estimate)
) %>% 
  left_join(
    left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("_vac_1", parameter)) %>% 
                separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("temp1","parameter", "temp2", "temp3")) %>% 
                select(parameter, run, estimate) %>% rename(vac = estimate),
              tabestimates_10 %>% filter(grepl("TLR7VAC_1", parameter)) %>% 
                separate(parameter, sep = "_", into = c("temp1","parameter", "temp2", "temp3")) %>% 
                select(parameter, run, estimate) %>% rename(tlr7vac = estimate))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(tlr7vac = mean*exp(tlr7vac)*exp(vac),
         vac = mean*exp(vac)) %>% 
  select(-mean) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(vac, tlr7vac), names_to = "group", values_to = "mean") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(mean))

density_data_by_treatment <- df %>%
  group_by(parameter, group) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x_vals <- exp(seq((min(log(.x$mean) - 4*.x$sd)),
                      (max(log(.x$mean) + 4*.x$sd)),
                      length.out = 500))
    do.call(rbind, lapply(1:nrow(.x), function(i) {
      data.frame(
        x = x_vals,
        y = dnorm(log(x_vals), mean = log(.x$mean[i]), sd = .x$sd[i]),
        run = as.factor(.x$run[i])
      )
    }))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

density_data_by_treatment %>% 
  left_join(tabestimates_10 %>% distinct(run, bicc) %>% mutate(run = factor(run))) %>% 
  ggplot( aes(x = x, y = y, color = bicc, group = run)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  facet_grid(group~parameter, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Normal Distributions by Parameter",
       x = "Value",
       y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  color_bicc() + 
  scale_x_log10()

# Shrinkage for each parameter
shrinkage %>% 
  filter(run %in% runs_10) %>% 
  left_join(distinct(tabestimates, run, bicc)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(factor(run), conditionalMode, fill = bicc)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, lty = "dashed") +
  fill_bicc() + 
  facet_wrap(~parameter) + 
  labs(x = "Run", y = "Shrinkage (%)") 
```
